messages:
jordan: Heads-up: saw another spike in partial streaming responses at ~03:15 UTC. Attaching short notes in the incident doc.
liz: saw it too. symptoms: client resumed -> server returned final fragment only, no middle chunks. looks like session queue starved by throttling.
omar: can you paste one of the request IDs? i'll trace.
jordan: req-9a2c3f. stack shows session-mux hit per-tenant rate limit, then session-mgr dropped mid-stream.
ronan: quick suggestion: bump idle timeout from 25s -> 75s for affected shard set. that's our fastest mitigation. will coordinate canary.
liz: we should also add a short-term alert: if resume_attempt_count > 3 within 60s then fire burn-rate alert to infra. owner: omar. due: tomorrow morning.
omar: ok i'll add the metric and a PagerDuty rule.
ronan: medium-term: implement resume optimistic ACKs so clients know server accepted resume before we try to stream tokens. estimate 3 weeks. owner: ronan.
jordan: long-term: redesign session placement to avoid eviction during active resumes and add per-session memory accounting. owner: jordan. due: next quarter.
liz: note on risks: increasing idle timeout may increase retained sessions and memory. ronan, coordinate with eng-infra for auto-scale tweaks and a revert plan.
ronan: revert plan: 1) roll back timeout, 2) drain idle sessions, 3) enable temporary connection cap for the tenant group. i'll write steps in the ticket.
incident-bot: created task INC-4921 -> https://board.redwood/INC-4921, automations attached.
jordan: recurring pattern callout: these partials cluster with tenant burst windows and micro-batching < 8. propose quarterly mapping of tenant burst profile -> batching policy. owner: liz, due: next retro.
oliver: :thinking_face: (not included in participants list, ignore)
liz: summarizing action items: 1) timeout canary (ronan, EOD) 2) resume_attempt alert (omar, +PD rule, by 12:00 UTC tomorrow) 3) optimistic-ack design (ronan, 3w) 4) session placement redesign (jordan, next quarter) 5) post-deploy smoke and memory watch (ronan + infra, after canary). react :thumbsup: to accept.
omar: :thumbsup:
ronan: :thumbsup:
jordan: :thumbsup:
